summary: Erasca, Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) on July 13, 2026, for an underwritten public offering of $500M of common stock, with an underwriter option for an additional $75M. At the last reported sale price of $18.53/share, this is a standard shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5). No special situation is present; it is a routine equity raise. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or structural event is noted. Watch for pricing and market reception, but there is no special-situation angle here.
